title: Tapas, drinks, and a wonderful cruise!
text: Our booking was very spontaneous and at the last minute. Our skipper and host accommodated our every need. What a beautiful surprise for a afternoon cruise. Our skipper was very professional and our host was very fun and made you feel at home. A beautiful short tour of the local coast and a circle out to take a stop for a dip if your up for it. The best 2 hours for a afternoon in Barcelona! Highly recommended.
author: 761claudew

title: Outstanding sunset cruise, swim, and tapas off the Barcelona coast!
text: Amazing cruise with delicious tapas, cava, wine, and a beautiful sunset. Ivy and Andie are an excellent team and highly qualified captain and first mate!  Really delightful and highly recommended.
author: zaccer1000

title: A fabulous trip!
text: We had a wonderful time with Captain Colin! I was anxious about this excursion from reading some of the previous reviews but we had a fantastic time! Cava was flowing and a great selection of tapas along with great views of the city and information about Barcelona. Would recommend!
author: Kathryn_H

title: Amazing boat tour!
text: I would highly recommend this tour!! Maria is an amazing host and made this tour sooo fun. The wine and tapas was delicious, and the boat is very well kept. Great music and amazing vibes overall. Was super nice to get out of the busy city for a while!
author: juliadT1864RY

title: Awesome!
text: My friends and I had a great time on the boat, the guides were very accommodating and provided great appetizers and drinks as listed!
author: 995reesep

title: A Perfect Sunday on the Water!
text: We had so much fun on this sailboat excursion with an incredible host and amazing captain! The tapas were delicious, and the atmosphere was fantastic. Any day is perfect for drinks in the sun on a boat, especially a Sunday! I highly recommend this trip to anyone looking for a memorable experience on the water.
author: 464almat

title: Sunset Sail
text: The crew was great - friendly and fun, but also clearly very experienced sailors. Kids loved swimming while the adults relaxed and enjoyed the views. A wonderful sunset sail!
author: curtandsallyf

title: Sunset sail
text: Slow and easy, we were able to see the shoreline, relax with some wine and snacks and then catch the beautiful sunset!  Faith and Matt were excellent hosts and made the trip fun!
author: Karen_D

title: Sunset Cruise 2022
text: Very enjoyable cruise. Met some really cool people and the crew was awesome. Even with overcast skies it was still fun.
author: Luann_H

title: Sunset Sail
text: We had an amazing sunset sail with Crew of Barcelona Watersports.  Working with them was very easy and they were a delight in the boat.  I will make sure to use them again the next time we are in Barcelona.
author: henryvK1936RL
